why: Found a 2025 Dabrowski-Villa paper (published in Trans. AMS 2025) proving positive analytic capacity for sets with 'plenty of big projections', described as related to Vitushkin's conjecture, but this is a sufficient-condition result on a different class of sets, not a resolution of the open direction of the conjecture itself (purely unrectifiable implies vanishing capacity, for infinite/non-sigma-finite Hausdorff measure). No source found claiming the open direction was proved, disproved, or otherwise moved since Jan 2024.
